newsitem.title: CONGO: Shooting erupts in Brazzaville - witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Shooting erupts in Brazzaville - witnesses.

text.p: Police in Congo's riverside capital Brazzaville opened fired on Wednesday when a group of people who crossed by canoe from Kinshasa ran off after trying to slip into the country unnoticed, witnesses said.

The incident follows the weekend takeover of Kinshasa by Laurent Kabila and his forces after toppling Zaire's veteran dictator Mobutu Sese Seko. The identity of the new arrivals was not immediately clear.
"We couldn't tell whether the other people were shooting back," one witness said.
Government sources say that Congo, dwarfed by its huge neighbour both in terms of population and territory, is keen to avoid an influx of fugitive Mobutu loyalists.
